note: Split-conformal on the LOG-SPACE score -log(1-alpha): threshold = k-th smallest calibration score, k=floor(eps*(n_cal+1)), which guarantees P(score(X_test) < threshold) <= eps. Because -log(1-alpha) is strictly increasing in alpha, quantiles are equivariant and the guarantee transfers to the alpha scale (zeta_hat = 1-exp(-threshold)). The linear affinity was tried first and is DEGENERATE in 5D: it saturates at exactly 1.0, so every calibration score tied at 1.0 and the threshold excluded nothing (poly5d, all eps). emp_false_excl is the measured ID exclusion on a disjoint test set; specificity_out is the fraction of true-outside points excluded.
